Legacy command intent:

ViewBS MethHeatmap --sample data/test_data/test_WT.tab.gz,WT --regions regions.bed --outdir out --prefix heat --context CG --context CHG --minDepth 1 --maxDepth 100 --merge

Expected output provenance:

The local legacy Perl entrypoint cannot be executed in this environment because Getopt::Long::Subcommand is not installed. This fixture uses the checked-in indexed methylation fixture data/test_data/test_WT.tab.gz and follows the checked-in legacy implementation in lib/Meth/Heatmap.pm:

- query each region for each sample and context;
- compute weighted methylation levels;
- when --merge is set, write context-sample columns in one merged matrix.
